policy.robots: Fetch robots.txt before crawling each host. Stop if its rules cannot be verified; never override a disallow rule.
policy.terms: Honor published site terms. Host entries may block collection or record reviewed terms URLs. Unknown terms are surfaced in manifests and health reports for review.
policy.access: Do not use authentication, evade rate limits, bypass access controls, or collect private data.
policy.retention: Keep raw snapshots content-addressed with hashes and retrieval provenance. Do not replace an earlier snapshot when content changes.

curling.io.permission_scope: The project owner confirmed existing written permission for Curler Tracker's automated collection, continued expansion, retention, and republication.
curling.io.permission_evidence: Owner confirmation recorded 2026-10-24; the permission document is retained outside this repository.
curling.io.reason: Automated collection and republication are authorized by written permission confirmed by the project owner. Respect any limits in that permission.
